name: Textile Coloration and Finishing Lab
description: Dyeing of textile fabrics and determination of time of half dyeing, activation energy, standard affinity and enthalpy, dye uptake from a binary mixture, light absorption/reflectance of dye mixtures, light reflectance from dyed fabrics (Kubelka-Munk analysis) instrumental assessment of color and color difference, functional finishing of textile using conventional and advanced techniques like plasma, layer by layer, sol gel and its evaluation.
